houseRules: Dispose of trash outside the gate

faqs.a: Check-in is from 2:00 PM. If the villa is ready sooner, we are happy to let you in early — just message us on the day.
No smoking anywhere indoors. A USD 300 cleaning penalty applies. You are welcome to smoke in the private garden.
The swimming pool, gym and clubhouse are a short walk within Orchard Park. A day-use fee of about USD 5 per person is payable at the clubhouse.

faqs.q: How do I use Google Home?
faqs.a: Just say "Hey Google" followed by your request — lights, AC, fans, TV and music all respond. See the Smart Home tab for exact phrases.
Please bag your trash and dispose of it in the bins outside the front gate. Keep the home clean and tidy during your stay.
Reconnect using the network and password in the Guide tab. If it persists, unplug the router for 20 seconds, then message us.
Use the remote on each nightstand or ask Google Home. We recommend 24°C for comfortable sleep in the tropics.
Enter the 5-digit PIN, then press the lock's key icon. If it still fails, message the host and we will let you in remotely.
